crossRefs.note: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.
Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
Yahweh turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.
Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to…
The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is…
For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now…
But godliness with contentment is great gain.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into…
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the…
He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father…

parallels.note: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land…

translations.web: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
translations.bsb: will fail to receive many times more in this age—and in the age to come, eternal life.”
translations.kjv: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
translations.asv: who shall not receive manifold more in this time, and in the world to come eternal life.
